services.name: Balloon Tethers
services.desc: Tethers are a great way to experience ballooning at events like family reunions, graduations, weddings or festivals. We bring the hot air balloon to your location and tie it down, allowing passengers to rise about 50 to 75 feet in the air. We can accommodate about 40 people an hour and can tether for multiple

includes: Brief tour of the shop (meeting location)
gap: Exact age minimum not stated, only recommendation against under 5 years
blurb: Guests experience approximately 1 hour of flight time in a hot air balloon, including a brief tour of the shop and a celebratory toast ceremony. Flights are scheduled with up to four passengers per balloon plus a pilot. Launch site is chosen on the day of flight based on wind conditions, with meeting at Monroe County Airport in Bloomington, Indiana.
extraNote: Credit card charged upon booking to hold spot · Flight decisions made by pilot; no refunds once flight leaves ground · Weather cancellations allow rescheduling; moderate to high winds (8+ MPH), rain, thunderstorms within 75 miles, low cloud ceiling, low visibility, or temperatures over 90°F cause cancellations · Cancellations require hours notice or payment is forfeited; $25 administrative non-refundable fee · No-shows or late arrivals forfeit full flight fare · Monroe County Airport in Bloomington, Indiana
